objectives: Explain what was counted to Abram for righteousness.
Interpret the prophecy of the seed being a stranger 400 years.
Show how the Most High reveals His secrets to the prophets in visions.
takeaways: The Most High prophesied an heir out of Abram's own bowels, and seed as the stars.
Righteousness is defined by the law: it shall be our righteousness if we observe to do all these commandments (Deuteronomy 6:25).
The deep sleep and horror of great darkness came before a vision of prophecy (Job 33:15-16; Amos 3:7).
The 400 years of Genesis 15:13 were fulfilled in Egypt and the Exodus (Exodus 12:40-41); it is not the 1619 doctrine.
Israel is yet this day in captivity and scattered (Baruch 3:8); the scattered tribes are the seed this covenant belongs to.
